name: manual_5bf0e6
claim: Skill rename/migration pattern: when a skill is renamed (no-sleep-chains -> shell-hygiene, 2026-06-13), the old path becomes a redirect stub that must never be edited for content. Cross-references in sibling repos (AlphaClaw/docs/Lessons.MD) become stale and must be updated to the new canonical path. The canonical target is bin/orama-system/skill/<new-name>/SKILL.md relative to repo root.

decisions.notes: Discovered during progressive disclosure: orama-system/bin/orama-system/skills/no-sleep-chains/SKILL.md is now a redirect stub; AlphaClaw Lessons.md still links to the old path. Pattern applies to all skill renames.
